feedback: Written before this candidate has raced, so I state no outcome for it. The Builder's geometry is the iteration 8 design, which has the most evidence in this race: 60/60 completions, oval and s-bend 20/20, slalom 20/20 with rms_error 0.0056 to 0.0099 m (iteration 8, score 939.3). Iterations 9 and 10 tested one change each from it. The 0.016 m sensor footprint (iteration 9) cut s-bend line loss from 0.85 to 0.70 but caused 4 slalom off-track endings (16/20), so sensor blur on sharp bends outweighs the dropouts it removes. The 0.044 m wheel (iteration 10) was the most recent test and is not carried forward. For this geometry I kept the iteration 8 controller: kp 3.8, ki 0.15 for the fixed motor mismatch, kd 0.65 (which damped s-bend oscillation to 0.34), base_speed 1.4, and sign-correct x/0.015 weights. This candidate is the final iteration, so no later geometry change can be tested. The requested changes below are the only remaining levers if the team wants them; they should be read as a note on the evidence, not as a plan for a further race.
requested_changes: Keep sensor_size at 0.012 m and wheel_radius at 0.040 m: iteration 9 (sensor 0.016 m) lost slalom finishes (16/20), and iteration 10 (wheel 0.044 m) left the line-loss and oscillation gap open, so neither change is supported.

Keep wheel_track at 0.105 m and body_width at 0.08 m: iteration 8 finished 60/60 at this track, and iteration 7 to 8 showed that narrowing the track raised slalom finishes from 15/20 to 20/20 without losing the s-bend.

If the Builder were ever to test again on this geometry, the first candidate would be a small wheel_track change (0.10 m) with kd raised to about 0.70, because iteration 8's s-bend oscillation of 0.34 is the nearest limit to a stability problem.
